notes: Source on disk (data/bill-text/119-HR-5366.txt) is the INTRODUCED version (Federal Disaster Tax Relief Act of 2025). Audited strictly against it per the source-only rule; all substantive prose is faithful to the introduced text (0 material contradictions). FRESHNESS CAVEAT (not a fidelity flag): the cache title and versionChanges indicate the bill was renamed and restructured by the Engrossed/Passed-House version (above-the-line 63(b)(8) deduction; 63(c)/56(b)(1)(D) and the 139M(d) window reportedly removed; incident period broadened to Dec 28 2019). If the engrossed text were fetched, several claims (AMT exemption, 63(c) standard-deduction path, the 2026-2030 wildfire window as a hard limit) would need re-audit. featured_quotes were not audited (no Congressional Record source provided; bill text cannot verify floor quotes).
